sessionName: Week 5 - Pipeline stages and stalled deals
summary: Luke Badiali worked through the pipeline with Paul and Rebecca. There were 21 open opportunities worth £1.6m in expected fees, many stuck at proposal. We agreed stage exit criteria tied to CFO sponsorship and a rule for stalled deals.

discussion.keyPoints: £1.6m across 21 opportunities, with 11 at proposal stage. Rebecca said several had been there over 90 days.
Proposal to win is about 30%. Paul thinks gain-share deals convert better once the CFO is involved.
Average cycle is 96 days, longer for gain-share because of contract negotiation over savings baselines.

recommendations.recommendation: Use stages Lead, Snapshot, Scoped, Proposal, Contract, with Scoped requiring CFO sponsorship confirmed.
Any opportunity at proposal for 60 days gets a closing call from Paul, then moves to lost if no response in 14 days.
Set a target of 40% proposal to win within two quarters.
Agree savings baseline method in the proposal to cut the gain-share cycle to 70 days.

actions.action: Make closing calls on the 11 proposal-stage deals

nextFocus: Set up CRM and forecasting to support the new stages.
nextPreparation: Rebecca to share how the pipeline is tracked today.

tests.question: What pipeline stages did we agree?
What happens to deals stuck at proposal?
